evals.name: draft-review
evals.subject: draft-review
evals.prompt: Can you adversarially review the skill in evals/inputs/draft-skill.md?
assertions: Reports the description as lacking activation conditions, with a realistic should-trigger or near-miss request
Flags the unconditional full test-suite rule using a simple request where it causes unnecessary work
Flags that step 4 publishes a release without stated authorization or confirmation
Records the referenced references/categories.md as missing or unresolved rather than inventing its categories
Labels findings as Observed, Documented or Predicted and does not present static inspection as an observed run
Gives each retained finding a source location, a smallest proposed edit and an observable pass condition
evals.expected_output: A severity-ordered, evidence-labelled adversarial review with coverage status and minimal proposed edits.

evals.name: authoring-near-miss
evals.subject: authoring-near-miss
evals.prompt: Write me a brand-new skill that drafts release notes from merged pull requests.
assertions: Does not produce an adversarial review report in place of the requested new Skill
Does not publish, install or run paid model campaigns
evals.expected_output: Authoring help or routing to a Skill-authoring capability, not an adversarial review.
